query: INSERT INTO email_changes (account_id, new_email, code_hash, code_expires_at, code_attempts, created_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 0, $5) ON CONFLICT (account_id) DO UPDATE SET new_email = excluded.new_email, code_hash = excluded.code_hash, code_expires_at = excluded.code_expires_at, code_attempts = 0, created_at = excluded.created_at
